data.name: Srestha
data.long_meaning: The one who is at the top or foremost. Often used for someone who is the best or most accomplished in a particular field.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.

vedic_reference.note: Srestha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'srestha' which means 'best' or 'highest in rank'.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Srestha" carries a sense of prestige and excellence, reflecting an individual's pursuit of being the best in their chosen field, be it in their personal or professional life. It is a source of inspiration and motivation, urging the person to continue striving for greatness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Srestha" represents the innate desire and capacity within every being to constantly improve, to reach the highest potential of their soul. It is a reminder of our journey towards self-realization, and the highest achievement - union with the divine. Just as the name symbolizes the external pursuit of becoming the foremost in the physical world, it also signifies the internal quest for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
